sourceArchive.verifiedBy: Downloaded twice independently on 2026-08-07 and confirmed byte-identical SHA-256 both times. See engine-src/upstream.lock and engine-src/README.md for the reproduction steps.

bundledFilesChecksumMethod: Extracted directly from the verified sourceArchive tarball (tar xzf, then sha256sum), not copied from a local `git clone` working directory. This matters: a local checkout's line endings can be silently rewritten by the cloning machine's git core.autocrlf setting, which would change the file's bytes/hash without changing its meaning. Extracting from the already checksum-verified archive avoids that entirely and keeps these hashes tied to the same verified artifact as sourceArchive.sha256.

bundledFiles.description: Full, unmodified GNU GPLv3 license text as distributed with pgn-extract at the pinned commit.
ECO (Encyclopaedia of Chess Openings) classification database distributed with pgn-extract, used by the engine's -e / --ecofile classification option.
bundledFiles.provenanceNote: eco.pgn carries its own in-file header comment (reproduced in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) crediting Ewart Shaw, Franz Hemmer 'and others' for the original compilation, and states that its author (David J. Barnes) was given permission for its inclusion with pgn-extract. Neither that header nor the upstream repository states an independent open-source license for eco.pgn itself - only permission to redistribute it with pgn-extract. This SOURCE.json and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md report that fact plainly rather than asserting a license eco.pgn does not itself declare.

notBundledYet.note: No pgn-extract *binary* (sidecar) is bundled in Phase 0. Only the license text, the ECO data file, and this identity record are bundled so far. Building and bundling the actual per-platform sidecar executable, and recording its own build-provenance/checksum, is Phase 1 scope - see src-tauri/binaries/README.md.
